name: meatspace_log_nicotine
description: Log nicotine use (cigarette, vape puff, pouch) to MortalLoom / Meatspace tracking. Use when the user says "I had a cigarette", "two pouches", "just vaped". Known categories (cigarette/vape/pouch) get sensible mgPerUnit defaults; otherwise specify mgPerUnit explicitly.

mgPerUnit.description: Nicotine milligrams per unit. Omit to use category default.
